title: Artesunate attenuates sepsis-induced myocardial injury: A preliminary investigation into the JAK2/STAT3 pathway via integrated network pharmacology and experimental validation.
authors: Li, Tongqin; Lv, Yating; Zhang, Jing; Rui, Haiying; Ma, Xin; Wang, Jiaqi; Jiang, Yujing; Yuan, Yamin; Meng, Yanfei; Ma, Xiaoxuan; Zheng, Xiaojuan; Yan, Xiaoxi; Li, Miaobo; Zhang, Bei; Dong, Xiaorong; Ma, Li
one_liner_zh: 该文研究青蒿琥酯通过JAK2/STAT3通路减轻脓毒症心肌损伤，虽含分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Sepsis, a life-threatening organ dysfunction caused by a dysregulated host response to infection, frequently induces myocardial injury, which stands as one of its most common and severe complications and a key factor contributing to poor patient prognosis. This study aims to investigate the protective effect of Artesunate (AS) on sepsis-induced myocardial injury (SIMI) and to elucidate the underlying molecular mechanisms by integrating network pharmacology prediction with experimental validation. METHODS: Sepsis was induced in male Wistar rats using the cecal ligation and puncture (CLP) method, and the rats were randomly divided into five groups (n = 6/group): Ctrl, Sham, CLP, AS + CLP, and vehicle + CLP. To assess the cardioprotective effect of AS, serum levels of myocardial injury markers (BNP, LDH, CK-MB, hs-cTnI) were measured by ELISA, and myocardial histopathology was evaluated by H&E staining. The potential targets and pathways of AS against SIMI were then predicted using network pharmacology. Serum inflammatory cytokines (IL-6, TNF-alpha) and oxidative stress markers (SOD, MDA) were further examined by ELISA, and cardiomyocyte apoptosis was assessed by TUNEL staining. Finally, the expression of key proteins in the JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway in myocardial tissue was determined by Western blotting to explore the underlying mechanism. RESULTS: AS significantly ameliorated pathological damage and reduced serum myocardial enzyme levels in septic rats compared to the CLP group. Network pharmacology identified 68 potential targets of AS. GO analysis revealed their primary enrichment in molecular functions such as kinase regulator activity, while KEGG enrichment analysis showed their significant association with pathways including inflammatory response. Molecular docking demonstrated favorable binding affinities between AS and core targets such as STAT3. Experimental validation further showed that AS treatment significantly decreased serum concentrations of IL-6 and TNF-alpha, increased SOD activity while reducing MDA content, and lowered the myocardial cell apoptosis index. Moreover, AS administration notably downregulated the protein expression levels of p-JAK2 and p-STAT3 in myocardial tissue. CONCLUSION: Based on network pharmacology prediction and experimental validation, it was demonstrated that AS protects against SIMI by inhibiting the JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway, thereby alleviating inflammation, oxidative stress, and cardiomyocyte apoptosis. These findings provide compelling pharmacological evidence for the drug repurposing of Artesunate.
abstract_zh: 背景：脓毒症（sepsis）是一种由宿主对感染反应失调引起的危及生命的器官功能障碍，常诱发心肌损伤，后者是其最常见且最严重的并发症之一，也是导致患者预后不良的关键因素。本研究旨在通过整合网络药理学预测与实验验证，探讨青蒿琥酯（Artesunate, AS）对脓毒症诱导心肌损伤（sepsis-induced myocardial injury, SIMI）的保护作用，并阐明其潜在分子机制。方法：采用盲肠结扎穿刺（cecal ligation and puncture, CLP）法诱导雄性Wistar大鼠脓毒症模型，并将大鼠随机分为五组（每组n = 6）：Ctrl、Sham、CLP、AS + CLP和vehicle + CLP。为评估AS的心脏保护作用，通过ELISA检测血清心肌损伤标志物（BNP、LDH、CK-MB、hs-cTnI）水平，并通过H&E染色评估心肌组织病理学变化。随后，利用网络药理学预测AS对抗SIMI的潜在靶点和通路。进一步通过ELISA检测血清炎症细胞因子（IL-6、TNF-alpha）和氧化应激标志物（SOD、MDA），并通过TUNEL染色评估心肌细胞凋亡。最后，通过Western blotting检测心肌组织中JAK2/STAT3信号通路关键蛋白的表达，以探讨其潜在机制。结果：与CLP组相比，AS显著改善了脓毒症大鼠的病理损伤，并降低了血清心肌酶水平。网络药理学鉴定出AS的68个潜在靶点。GO分析显示这些靶点主要富集于激酶调节活性等分子功能，而KEGG富集分析显示其与炎症反应等通路显著相关。分子对接结果表明AS与STAT3等核心靶点具有良好的结合亲和力。实验验证进一步显示，AS治疗显著降低了血清IL-6和TNF-alpha浓度，增加了SOD活性并降低了MDA含量，同时降低了心肌细胞凋亡指数。此外，AS给药显著下调了心肌组织中p-JAK2和p-STAT3的蛋白表达水平。结论：基于网络药理学预测和实验验证，证明AS通过抑制JAK2/STAT3信号通路，从而减轻炎症、氧化应激和心肌细胞凋亡，对SIMI发挥保护作用。这些发现为青蒿琥酯的药物再利用提供了有力的药理学证据。
